**Subject: Tuesday reading club – an update before the review**

Dear Niamh,

I wanted to give you an update on the Tuesday reading club before the review meeting on Wednesday 18 November, and to ask if you would reconsider the planned pause from January.

I know your email of 30 October mentioned both low attendance and the increase in hall insurance, so I appreciate there is more than one thing to consider. But the numbers have really picked up. We had five children most weeks in September, nine by the middle of October, and 14 last Tuesday, 3 November. It feels as though word is finally getting around.

The club has been running since September 2025, on Tuesdays from 3.30 to 4.45 in the upstairs meeting room at Knocknacarra library, and it would be a terrible pity to pause it just as it’s taking off. Declan Moran at Salthill Book Nook has also donated 120 books, mostly for the six-to-nine age group, with a good few as Gaeilge. It was a lovely thing for him to do, and the children are already enjoying having more to choose from.

There have been some lovely moments lately, too. Two sisters from a Ukrainian family joined us in October, and the older one now reads to the younger one in English at the end of each session. And a boy who wouldn’t open a book in September asked last week if he could take two home. I came away that day absolutely thrilled.

There is one other matter I want to tell you about directly. I met Orla Keane from the Corrib Courier at the farmers’ market and got carried away telling her about the club. I said, “Come along any Tuesday,” and told her she could bring a photographer. She would like to visit on Tuesday 24 November.

I was wrong not to check with you first, plain and simple. I know that photographs of the children need your sign-off and the parental consent forms. I’m sorry I went ahead of the proper process.

The coverage could be wonderful for the club, but only if it’s done properly. I’m happy to ring Orla and put the visit on hold until you’ve had a chance to decide. If you do say yes, I can collect the consent forms myself.

I hope the new attendance figures can be considered at the review on the 18th. I understand the insurance cost still has to be weighed up, but I’d be very glad if we could find a way to keep the club going.

Many thanks, Niamh.

Best wishes,  
[Your name]
